description: Add pinned ask_user_question support to the project Pi harness.

userStories.description: As an advisor, I want package compatibility evidence so that the integration uses a verified release.
acceptanceCriteria: Install Pi and `@juicesharp/rpiv-ask-user-question@2.15.0` in a fresh temporary directory inside the sandbox without model calls.

Verify tool registration, a structured answer, cancellation, and non-interactive tool removal through the real package entry point.
Remove temporary resources and leave the running advisor session unchanged.
userStories.notes: Executed: advisor reran fresh npm installation and probe.mjs through agro run from the main checkout detached at the integrated story commit; exit 0. acceptanceCriteria: Add a failing settings regression before the configuration change.

Document project trust, package installation, fresh-session activation, terminal questions, cancellation, RPC fallback, and headless behavior in `docs/harnesses/pi.md`.

Add an issue-linked entry under `CHANGELOG.md` Unreleased.
